title: Colour one pixel
heading: Now colour a pixel with Python.
description: This is the same 8 × 5 picture. pixel(2, 1) colours one whole cell: column 2, row 1. Try (0, 0), then (7, 4). Increase y to move down; increase x to move right.

scene.title: Your picture · 8 × 5 enlarged pixels
scene.label: An enlarged 8-column, 5-row pixel picture. Whole cells are shaded; x counts right from 0 to 7 and y counts down from 0 to 4.

feedback.empty: Your program ran. Add pixel(...) to colour your picture.
